rules.name: npm cache
rules.hint: Clears the npm package cache. Packages download again on the next install. Close Node tools first.
rules.description: Deletes the npm cache folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\npm-cache), the same data 'npm cache clean --force' removes. Installed node_modules folders are not touched. The next installs download packages again.
rules.sideEffects: The next npm installs are slower and need network access.

rules.name: pip cache
rules.hint: Clears the pip download and wheel cache. Packages download again on the next install.
rules.description: Deletes the pip cache (%LOCALAPPDATA%\pip\Cache), the same data 'pip cache purge' removes. Installed packages and virtual environments are not touched.
rules.sideEffects: The next pip installs are slower and need network access.

rules.name: Yarn cache
rules.hint: Clears the Yarn (classic) package cache. Packages download again on the next install.
rules.description: Deletes the Yarn classic cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Yarn\Cache, the same data 'yarn cache clean' removes. Project folders are not touched.
rules.sideEffects: The next yarn installs are slower and need network access.

rules.name: NuGet HTTP cache and scratch
rules.hint: Clears NuGet's HTTP cache and temp scratch folders. The global packages folder is kept.
rules.description: Deletes the NuGet v3 HTTP cache and the NuGetScratch temp folder, like 'dotnet nuget locals http-cache --clear'. The global packages folder (~\.nuget\packages) is not touched, so builds keep working offline.
rules.sideEffects: Package metadata is downloaded again on the next restore.

rules.name: VS Code caches and logs
rules.hint: Clears VS Code's cached data, downloaded extension installers and logs. VS Code must be closed.
rules.description: Deletes VS Code's CachedData, CachedExtensionVSIXs, web cache and log folders. Installed extensions, settings and workspaces are not touched. VS Code must be closed.
rules.sideEffects: VS Code starts a little slower once.

rules.name: Gradle caches
rules.hint: Clears the Gradle build cache and downloaded dependencies. The next build downloads everything again.
rules.description: Deletes ~\.gradle\caches, which holds downloaded dependencies and build-cache entries. Projects are not touched, but the next build is much slower and needs network access. Stop Gradle daemons first.
rules.sideEffects: The next Gradle builds are slow and need network access.

rules.name: Maven local repository
rules.hint: Clears the Maven local repository (~\.m2\repository). The next build downloads all dependencies again.
rules.description: Deletes the Maven local repository. Artifacts you installed locally with 'mvn install' are removed too and must be rebuilt. The next build downloads all dependencies again.
rules.sideEffects: Locally installed artifacts are removed; builds re-download dependencies.

rules.name: Docker Desktop disk usage
rules.hint: Shows how much space Docker Desktop's disk image uses. Clean it with 'docker system prune' instead of deleting files.
rules.description: Reports the size of Docker Desktop's WSL disk image. Deleting the file would destroy all images, containers and volumes, so iG Windows Tuner only shows the size. Use 'docker system prune' and Docker Desktop's Troubleshoot page to reclaim space.
rules.notes: Guidance only: run 'docker system prune' (and Docker Desktop > Troubleshoot > Clean / Purge data) to reclaim space.
